name: Source readiness
questionAnswered: How many source families in the named assessment plan have passed the stated readiness checks as of the projection time?

calculation.formula: ready planned source families divided by all planned source families in the named scope
calculation.numeratorDefinition: Planned source families with an admitted interface, authorized read-only route, successful capability probe, and named operating function.
calculation.denominatorDefinition: All source families explicitly listed in the approved source-enablement plan for the named scope.
calculation.rounding: Retain six decimal places in machine output; display percentages may round to one decimal place.

scopeSemantics.qualification: Readiness is limited to the planned source families and checks named by the referenced source-enablement plan.

interpretation.doesMean: The stated fraction of planned source families is technically ready for the bounded assessment workflow.
doesNotMean: The enterprise cryptographic estate is completely inventoried.
Every record exposed by a ready source is accurate.
The source is authorized for write operations.
interpretation.whenUnavailable: Show unavailable and identify the missing or empty source-enablement plan; do not display zero percent.
